description: This file defines a base activity class for Android applications, providing common logging setup and lifecycle methods. It extends FragmentActivity and initializes logging infrastructure in onStart.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base activity class that extends FragmentActivity and sets up logging.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback to perform initial creation, currently only calls the super implementation.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle callback called when the activity becomes visible; it calls initializeLogging().

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain by creating a LogWrapper instance and configuring the Log system; also logs a 'Ready' message.
